title: Cataclysm 0.8 — executive order: permanent companion builds and randomized roguelite progression
prompt:
EXECUTIVE PRODUCER ORDER — Implement actual gameplay changes in the CURRENT published Cataclysm 0.8, following the accepted correction cataclysm-08-correction-001. Keep the human-facing title, runtime BUILD, boot/version handshake and all release metadata exactly Cataclysm 0.8, using a NEW technical build/run ID to distinguish source. No 0.9, no new game, no studio/infrastructure redesign, no rerecording/transcription, no unbounded retries. Stable /preview/ URL. Existing long-run enemy pacing, optimized uncapped progression, mobile controls, scoreboard, pause/restart, music and other working mechanics must survive. Review actual current game code and game_factory/CATACLYSM_1_0_ROADMAP.md before planning.

P0 PERMANENT COMPANION INVESTMENT BRANCH: Existing summonCompanion() creates one activeCompanion with a ~35-60 second life and replaces the previous one; updateSupport expires it. This is explicitly unwanted. Recruit a companion as a PERMANENT follower for that run: no life timer, no vanishing after 45 seconds, no replacement of existing allies when acquiring a different role; followers persist through pause/upgrade sequences until death/game over or intentional restart. Permit a squad of different follower types (at minimum shooter / healer / tank from the current game) concurrently, each with distinct utility, readable positioning and behavior, and synergistic benefits. The player's real investment is in building the squad, not hiring one disposable support effect. Upgrade compatibility: if legacy 'pet-companion' or companion-shooter/healer/tank choices remain, map them to coherent recruiting/training without duplicate phantom companions or overwriting allies. Preserve ghost-silence workaround only where consistent.

P1 CORE ROGUELITE LEVEL-UP OFFERINGS: Replace the current deterministic offset rotation and compulsory 'recover' third button. Every level-up displays THREE distinct, RANDOMLY sampled *eligible* choices from a weighted pool, with no duplicate offerings in one menu. Common choices: (1) player damage, (2) player fire rate, (3) move speed, (4) XP gain % modifier, (5) companion branch investments AFTER any follower is acquired: companion damage as a percentage of current PLAYER damage, companion firing rate, and number of companion slots/count. Exact balancing to Designer/Producer, but boosts must apply to REAL combat and progression and stack with later choices. XP gain must affect actual XP received from collected fish/other XP-awarding events without falsifying fish score/counter or corrupting multi-level pending XP. Display clear numerical effect text (old -> new) and current build in HUD/guide where feasible. Do not regress continuous scaling from the corrective 0.8, and no hidden old caps. 'Recover' may be a situational common option, NOT guaranteed every menu.

P1 RANDOM SPECIAL CHOICES, SAME MENU: Special upgrades must be offered randomly at appropriate rarity/weight across level-ups, not only on fixed modulo-3 levels. The special pool MUST include (a) recruit companion / choose new follower archetype, (b) player's multi-shot, (c) player's bouncing bullets/ricochet, (d) COMPANION multi-shot, (e) COMPANION bouncing bullets, (f) Cat's Catch (fish pickup magnet/range). Companion-specific specials become eligible when at least one follower exists; they affect real follower bullets, their damage and targeting/bounce handling. Followers can have upgrade synergies: more followers with companion damage %, companion shot rate, spread and ricochet create a distinct strategic build; no fake generic passive stats. Permit repeated meaningful investments and avoid arbitrary count caps; use bounded visible entities with aggregated damage/squad effectiveness if mobile performance needs a technical limit. Ensure changing/shooting follower types does not silently wipe investments. Design weighting/unlock gating that prevents a special-only or all-companion offer on early levels before a player can use it; still allow rare early companion recruitment. Use a reproducible seed for tests (do NOT force identical menus each run); expose read-only diagnostic snapshots of seed/level/offered IDs/squad/stats.

P0 REMOVE AURA ACTIVATION MENU: Delete the manual 'Support · beacon deployment' / 'Beacon aura' dropdown, Deploy beacon button and related menu-driven activation UI in docs/preview/index.html and associated CSS/JS and help/status text. The user has rejected this aura activation menu. Retire manual beacon-upgrade menu entries and obsolete click handlers; if desirable, rehome useful fire/healing/guard synergies in passive follower behavior, with zero manual aura panel required. Do NOT accidentally remove unrelated rune pickups/activation or Feral Instinct mechanics. Keep game interface LITE: game and a compact, uncluttered HUD.

RANDOMNESS AND QA: Use seeded or injectable PRNG separated from cosmetic randomness as appropriate. Test offer diversity across multiple levels and runs, correct weighted selection, valid gating, exactly one chosen upgrade and no frozen UI; test XP multiplier with single fish pickup and multiple successive level-ups; test follower 10, 20, and 30 simulation minutes without expiration, plus pause/restart; tests for simultaneous shooter+healer+tank and count scaling, companion DPS scaling, companion spread and bounce functionality; nontrivial stress test with many invested companions/attacks on mobile Chrome at 360x780 and 390x844. Existing enemy unlock thresholds remain staged through 20 min. Show concrete tests, files changed, constraints and remaining limitations in the coder report. Independent browser QA and verified deployed bytes required. Do not claim physical Samsung verification. If an important requested feature cannot actually be implemented and tested, fail acceptance rather than saying it was done.

Priority: persistent allies + correct randomized usable upgrade loop + removal of rejected aura menu are NONNEGOTIABLE. Preserve prior functioning Cataclysm gameplay, including current 0.8 corrective pacing. This is a new technical revision of SAME GAME VERSION. Do not alter BoRHeZ Games Studio project architecture or other games.
acceptance: Displayed and runtime version stays exactly 0.8; a fresh technical build identifier and unique accepted commit distinguish this revision.
A recruited follower persists to end of its run, including beyond 45 seconds and through 10, 20 and 30-minute simulated play, and only resets with the run; no life-based desummon.
At least shooter, healer and tank can coexist simultaneously without replacing each other; distinct roles and consistent squad persistence demonstrated.

Common upgrade choices include damage, fire rate, move speed and XP gain; post-recruitment companion damage as % of player damage, companion fire rate and companion number/count make real cumulative changes.

Special pool randomly offers companion recruitment, player multishot, player ricochet, companion multishot, companion bouncing bullets and Cat's Catch; follower-specific upgrades require a follower and work in combat.
Exactly three unique, randomly weighted eligible cards appear at each level-up, not fixed rotation; do not force Recover in every menu; multiple seeds and levels demonstrate varied choices.
Selection pauses all game timers, accepts exactly one choice, resumes play, resolves successive XP-triggered levels without softlock and handles very high XP gain correctly.
Manual beacon aura deployment panel, dropdown, button, special choices and handlers are removed; unrelated rune and Feral mechanics are preserved.
Companion multishot/ricochet/damage/rate/count scale in real projectile and collision behavior, with performance controls that do not impose arbitrary progression caps.
Current 0.8 corrective enemy introduction timing through 20+ minutes, survivability systems, touch controls, sound, restart and score survive with no regressions.
Independent gameplay-level deterministic tests and touch-emulated 360x780 / 390x844 tests validate persistent allies, randomized menus, XP math, synergy and stress behavior; QA evidence is recorded.
Only accept, publish and verify live /preview/ bytes if ALL required features and tests pass; retain previous accepted release and report unverified physical-device behavior truthfully.
